item.title: Pakistan braces for heavy rain, storms April 1-4 nationwide.
item.description: Pakistan Met Office forecasts a 'significant' westerly wave bringing heavy rain, wind, and thunderstorms to Balochistan from April 1st, then extending nationwide until April 4th with isolated heavy falls and hail likely.

item.title: Punjab government launches Lahore SRT Yellow Line targeting swift launch with Rs. 8 billion.
item.description: Lahore is set to get a modern Smart Rapid Transport (SRT) system along its Yellow Line. The Punjab government aims for a swift launch within a month, promising daily service for over 12,000 passengers on this 26 km route. An investment of up to Rs. 8 billion.

item.title: Punjab Boards reveal full 2026 Matric Inter schedule crucial for students.
item.description: Punjab's educational boards have unveiled the full 2026 academic calendar, detailing annual exam dates, result announcements, and supplementary exam schedules for Matric and Intermediate students. Get all deadlines and key dates here!

item.title: FBR sets new customs values for imported Pepsi and Coke in Pakistan.
item.description: Pakistan's FBR, through its Customs Valuation Karachi Directorate, has set 'new customs values' for imported carbonated drinks. This update affects major brands like Pepsi, Coke, and Sprite, replacing a 'nine-year-old ruling' to ensure 'fair assessment' of duties and taxes, following 'detailed market analysis' and stakeholder input.

item.title: KP Govt mandates new school timings for primary schools with Moral Training by March 31.
item.description: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa introduces 'new school hours' for public primary schools from March 31, 2026. This 'revised timetable' emphasizes 'mandatory moral training', 'speeches', and 'literary sessions' for holistic student development. District Education Officers are now tasked with 'strict implementation' across the province.

item.title: China launches world-first Open-Sea Floating Island by SJTU for deep-sea exploration by 2030.
item.description: China officially launched the 'Open-Sea Floating Island,' the world's first ultra-large marine research platform. Led by Shanghai Jiao Tong University, this project aims to revolutionize deep-sea science, resource exploration, and disaster prevention, set to be fully operational by 2030.

item.title: IMF pushes Pakistan to end fuel and housing tax exemptions for Rs. 15.6 trillion target
item.description: The 'IMF' pushes Pakistan to eliminate fuel and housing tax exemptions, targeting a 'Rs. 15.6 trillion' revenue for fiscal year 2026-27. Learn about the 'proposed changes' and government's 'resistance' in ongoing 'budget talks'.

item.title: Federal Board of Revenue takes strict action against Customs officers for misconduct to ensure accountability.
item.description: The Federal Board of Revenue initiates strict disciplinary action against customs officers involved in unauthorized attachments, misconduct, and absence. New directives aim to bolster internal oversight and ensure accountability.

item.title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government boosts Sehat Card Plus budget to Rs48B to clear dues.
item.description: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government has dramatically 'increased the Sehat Card Plus budget' from Rs36B to Rs48B annually, raising monthly allocations to Rs4B. This vital move aims to clear 'hospital outstanding payments', ensuring uninterrupted 'free healthcare services' for millions across the province and reducing the burden on major facilities.

item.title: Pakistan`s oil industry warns of fuel crisis over new PM-formed pricing.
item.description: Pakistan's oil industry strongly opposes new fuel pricing changes by a PM-formed committee. They warn of disrupted supplies and a looming 'fuel crisis', citing ignored commercial realities and existing financial strains.
